notes.title: Trading Cards released
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

we are happy to announce that as of today the game features Trading Cards, badges, profile backgrounds and emoticons.

Also, I think that cat lovers will like the emoticons from this game :)

Vedran Klanac,
creator of Slide Ride Arcade
